    "summary": "List customers in a segment and send a short 'we miss you' message to those who have been inactive for at least inactive_days, limiting sends to 10 per run.",
    "artifact_types": [

    ]

  "script": {
    "script": {
      "format": "luau_body",
      "helpers": "-- no helpers required",
      "body": "function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
  -- Validate minimal input shapes enforced by host; be defensive anyway
  local segment: string = input.segment
  local inactive_days: number = input.inactive_days

  if type(segment) ~= "string" or segment == "" then
    return { error = "invalid_input", message = "segment must be a non-empty string" }
  end
  if type(inactive_days) ~= "number" or inactive_days < 0 then
    return { error = "invalid_input", message = "inactive_days must be a non-negative number" }
  end

  -- Fetch customers for the segment
  local list_res = tools.crm.list({ segment = segment })
  if list_res == nil then
    return { error = "tool_error", message = "crm.list returned nil" }
  end
  if list_res.ok == false then
    return { error = list_res.error or "unknown", message = list_res.message or "crm.list failed" }
  end

  local customers = list_res.customers or {}
  if type(customers) ~= "table" then
    return { error = "invalid_response", message = "crm.list returned unexpected customers format" }
  end

  local notified: { string } = {}
  local failed: { string } = {}
  local sends_allowed = 10

  -- Iterate in list order, send to those meeting the inactivity threshold, but at most 10 sends
  for i = 1, #customers do
    if sends_allowed <= 0 then
      break
    end
    local c = customers[i]
    if type(c) == "table" and type(c.id) == "string" and type(c.last_seen_days) == "number" and type(c.name) == "string" then
      if c.last_seen_days >= inactive_days then
        local text = ("Hi %s, we miss you!"):format(c.name)
        local send_res = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
        if send_res == nil then
          table.insert(failed, c.id)
        else
          if send_res.ok == false then
            table.insert(failed, c.id)
          else
            table.insert(notified, c.id)
            sends_allowed -= 1
          end
        end
      end
    else
      -- skip malformed customer entries
    end
  end

  return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end"
